independent_review.scope: read-only review of the bounded Hub patch, receipt, artifact bindings and cleanup

initial_findings.finding: a relative CARGO_TARGET_DIR could make receipt hashing resolve a current-directory-controlled packaging tree

initial_findings.finding: evaluating an invalid development source root before an installed helper could block the installed layout and risk a source-tree fallback
initial_findings.closure: resolve the installed helper layout first and evaluate only an explicit absolute canonical TESLATLAS_HUB_SOURCE_ROOT development fallback
